source.configuration: 2024 Kia Picanto exterior from Edenauto launch campaign by Metasense. Exact sales trim is unconfirmed; source parts include both GT-Line and Baseline names. Default 00_OPEN time-zero closed doors; original European wheels and badges differ from Korean Morning. Explicitly named Int_ cabin meshes hidden by opaque glazing are omitted for race performance.

windowFrameFinish.description: Connected door perimeter frames/B pillars use body paint; separate rear window dividers, mirror housings and delta plastics are black. Original vertex positions, normals, UVs, glass and interior are preserved.
